***

Nestled in the industrial heart of Germany’s North Rhine-Westphalia region, PETREX GMBH, headquartered at Wachtendonker Straße 11 in Kempen, has established itself as a distinguished and highly specialized force in the European polymer industry. Far more than a simple chemical supplier, PETREX operates as a premier distributor and expert compounder, with a focused expertise in thermoplastic polyesters, most notably polyethylene terephthalate (PET). The company serves as a critical link in the supply chain, bridging the gap between large-scale polymer producers and the diverse manufacturing sectors that rely on high-performance materials for their end products.

PETREX’s core business revolves around providing a comprehensive portfolio of both virgin and recycled PET grades, as well as custom-developed compounds tailored to meet the exacting specifications of its clients. This specialization allows them to cater to a wide array of demanding industries, including beverage and food packaging, automotive engineering, electronics, and technical textiles. By leveraging its deep technical knowledge, the company collaborates closely with clients to develop materials with specific properties, such as enhanced strength, thermal stability, or flame retardancy. With a firm commitment to quality, reliability, and sustainability—evidenced by its strong focus on recycled PET (rPET)—PETREX GMBH is not just a distributor but a strategic partner dedicated to delivering innovative, efficient, and responsible material solutions to a competitive global market.
